groups.name: spring.setting.admin.web
groups.description: Wire-level configuration for the admin REST surface.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors
groups.description: CORS settings for the admin paths, independent of the host application's CORS.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.acl
groups.description: Per-operation role mapping for the admin REST surface.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults
groups.description: Per-operation fallback roles applied when a profile omits an operation. Empty set denies access.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.global
groups.description: Roles for operations not bound to a single setting type.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth
groups.description: Selects how the admin REST endpoints authenticate callers.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.basic
groups.description: HTTP Basic credentials for BASIC auth mode. Never enable in production.

groups.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.noop
groups.description: NOOP auth mode configuration. A synthetic Authentication is injected carrying the configured roles.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.enabled
properties.description: Strict opt-in flag. Adding the dependency does not expose endpoints until this is true.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.base-path
properties.description: URL prefix for all admin endpoints. Override to fit an existing URL space.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Origins allowed to make cross-origin requests to the admin endpoints.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: HTTP methods allowed in CORS preflight responses.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Request headers that are allowed in CORS requests.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: Response headers that browsers are allowed to access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether the browser should include credentials (cookies, authorization headers) in CORS requests.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.cors.max-age
properties.description: How long the result of a preflight request can be cached by the browser.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.read
properties.description: Roles allowed to read a setting when no profile-specific rule exists. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.patch
properties.description: Roles allowed to patch a setting when no profile-specific rule exists. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.replace
properties.description: Roles allowed to replace a setting when no profile-specific rule exists. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.delete
properties.description: Roles allowed to delete a setting when no profile-specific rule exists. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.history
properties.description: Roles allowed to view the audit history of a setting when no profile-specific rule exists. Only evaluated when spring.setting.audit.enabled=true. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.defaults.revert
properties.description: Roles allowed to revert a setting to a prior audit-log value when no profile-specific rule exists. Only evaluated when spring.setting.audit.enabled=true. Empty set denies access.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.global.list
properties.description: Roles allowed to list all setting types.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.acl.profiles
properties.description: Per-profile role overrides keyed by setting type simple name (the ACL profile). Overrides defaults for the operations specified.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.mode
properties.description: Authentication mode for the admin endpoints: KEYCLOAK (OAuth2 JWT), BASIC (HTTP Basic), or NOOP (no auth, dev only).

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.basic.username
properties.description: Username for HTTP Basic authentication in BASIC mode.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.basic.password
properties.description: Password for HTTP Basic authentication in BASIC mode.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.basic.roles
properties.description: Roles granted to the hardcoded Basic auth user.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.noop.roles
properties.description: Roles attached to the synthetic Authentication inserted by the NOOP filter.

properties.name: spring.setting.admin.web.auth.noop.synthetic-principal
properties.description: Principal name set on the synthetic Authentication in NOOP mode.

values.description: OAuth2 JWT bearer auth via a ReactiveJwtDecoder. Requires spring-setting-admin-keycloak on the classpath.
HTTP Basic with a hardcoded user. For local dev and QA only — never use in production.
No authentication. A synthetic Authentication carrying configured roles is injected. Intended for tests and local dev.
